base: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished, exceptionally beautiful original AhoiBrowser macOS 26 Liquid Glass browser screen design reference, landscape 1440x900. Straight-on crisp screenshot, no perspective, no annotations outside UI, no other brands/logos/assets. German UI only, SF Pro typography. Quiet premium editorial aesthetic, restrained sea-teal accent, beautiful spacing. Full browser window with traffic lights top left, unified softly frosted continuous glass window background/sidebar/frame surrounding completely opaque web cards radius 14 pt. Glass NEVER coats web content. Sidebar width 236, workspace switcher top 'Privat' with three small workspace dots, sections 'Gespeichert' and 'Heute', folder 'Reiseideen', tabs 'Startseite', 'Küstenwege', split group a SINGLE row 'Planung · 4 Ansichten', bottom settings icon. Thin floating navigation row at top of web area with back/forward, security icon and fictional origin 'kuestenwege.example'; subtle reveal notch. SF Pro 13pt sidebar, 15pt body, 28pt headings. Radius embedded 14, panels 18, rows 8; 8/12/16/24 spacing. Native frosted optical material, extremely subtle rim highlights and shadows, never plastic or excessive shine. Content and icons original. All labels readable German.

themes.hell: LIGHT theme: warm white opaque web content, graphite text, seafoam frosted glass with milk lift 55%, delicate teal background.
themes.dunkel: DARK theme: opaque deep graphite web content, off-white text, graphite frosted glass with milk lift 12%, muted dark teal backdrop. Truly dark overall, restrained glowing edges, accessible contrast.

assembly: base + " " + themes[theme] + " " + motif[1]; transparent_background=false. First image used identical text with two adjacent spaces before LIGHT.
